test_title: RRB Group D Official Paper (Held On: 14 Dec, 2025 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: The average of 12 numbers is 58. The average of the first 5 numbers is 55, and the average of the next 4 numbers is 62. If the 10th number is 10 less than the 11th number and is 5 more than the 12th number, then the average of the 11th and 10th numbers is:6560
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Net deviation = 5 × (55 − 58) + 4 × (62 − 58) = −15 + 16 = +1

For the average to be 58, the sum of the last 3 numbers = 3 × 58 − (Net Deviation) = 174 − 1 = 173.

Let 10th number = x; then 11th = x + 10; and 12th = x − 5.

x + x + 10 + x − 5 = 173 ⇒ 3x = 168 ⇒ x = 56

Average of 10th and 11th = (56 + 66) ÷ 2 = 61

**∴ The correct answer is 61.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Average of 12 numbers = 58

Average of first 5 numbers = 55

Average of next 4 numbers = 62

**Formula Used:**

Sum = Average × Count

 
• 
• First 5 Next 4 Last 3 Sum = 5 × 55 = 275 Sum = 4 × 62 = 248 Sum = 173 
• 
• 
• Total Sum of 12 numbers = 12 × 58 = 696 Last 3 Sum = Total − (First 5 + Next 4) = 696 − (275 + 248) = 173 10th + 11th + 12th = x + (x+10) + (x−5) = 173 

**Calculations:**

⇒ Total sum of 12 numbers = 12 × 58 = 696

⇒ Sum of first 5 numbers = 5 × 55 = 275

⇒ Sum of next 4 numbers = 4 × 62 = 248

⇒ Sum of last 3 numbers = 696 − (275 + 248) = 173

⇒ Let the 10th number be x.

⇒ 11th number = x + 10

⇒ 12th number = x − 5

⇒ Sum of the last 3 numbers = x + (x + 10) + (x − 5)

⇒ 3x + 5 = 173

⇒ 3x = 168

⇒ x = 56 (10th number)

⇒ 11th number = 56 + 10 = 66

⇒ Average of 10th and 11th numbers = (56 + 66) ÷ 2 = 122 ÷ 2 = 61

**∴ The correct answer is 61.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Weighted Average

When combining multiple groups, the overall average is calculated as (n₁A₁ + n₂A₂ + ...) ÷ (n₁ + n₂ + ...).

Net Deviation Method

The sum of deviations of all individual observations from their true mean is always zero. Deviation is calculated as Observation − Average.
